name: How long does a drywall texture repair take to complete?

mainEntity.name: How long does a drywall texture repair take to complete?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most small to mid-sized drywall texture repairs take one to two days to complete properly. While hanging the patch and spraying or troweling the texture takes only a few hours of hands-on labor, joint compound and texture spray must dry thoroughly between coats before painting. High indoor humidity or thicker applications like heavy knockdown can extend drying times. Planning for primer and paint application the following day ensures the compound cures fully without flashing or peeling.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most repairs take one to two days. Actual work takes a few hours, but mud and texture require adequate drying time between coats before priming and painting.
